reviews.body: Overall LGTM, thanks @pcbeingused333, but I would address Greptile's comment

review_comments.body: **Original error remains untested** This test always supplies `dimensions=1024`, so it never reaches the new `size is None` branch. Add a case for a custom model with `zero_on_failure=True` and no `dimensions`, and assert that the original exception is raised unchanged. That would protect the fix from hiding the server’s error behind a `KeyError` again. Note: If this suggestion doesn't match your team's coding style, reply to this and let me know. I'll remember it for next time!
This makes sense to me, we should probably adapt this test so `dimensions=None` instead. Wdyt?

I’d keep this test as-is: it verifies that a custom model with explicit dimensions returns a zero vector of the requested size. Changing it to `dimensions=None` would test a different branch and lose coverage of that behavior. Add a separate no-dimensions case that asserts the original `API Error` is re-raised rather than a `KeyError`.

This PR removes built-in model lookups that fail for custom OpenAI-compatible embedding models. - Custom OpenAI-compatible models use their requested dimensions for output types. - Failed custom-model requests can return zero vectors of the requested size.
